scope: Nineteen post-packet open drafts selected from the current completion run; older pre-1008 backlog intentionally excluded.
method: Fetched direct get_pr_info metadata for all nineteen PRs.
Verified each exact head with git merge-base --is-ancestor against current main.
Computed earliest covering first-parent merge and head containment in other inspected open PRs.
Read current PR bodies and seven relevant discussion/review timelines.
No product tests were executed; all test counts remain creator-reported.
limits: This is a remote source and evidence reconciliation, not merge/release approval.
The original Mac, unpushed worktrees and local completion-run ledger have not been inspected.
No new installation is established. The transcript reports the previous installed app recovered after disk-full Docker failure.
A GitHub mergeable flag does not establish acceptance. Bot review guides do not count as submitted independent reviews.
Any source updates after this snapshot require head and evidence revalidation.
A head absent from main does not imply every constituent change is absent: cherry-picks or later equivalent implementations were not classified by this ancestry-only closure test.
closure_rule: Close only the six exact entire heads already in main, with comment linking #1109 and the evidence. Describe them as integrated source maps, not new merges or full audit acceptance. Keep the thirteen unmerged heads open, including those contained only in unmerged aggregates.
